function.name: sky_nws_watch
function.description: Fetch live NOAA/NWS active severe weather alerts, forecast office metadata, nearest surface observation, and local 3h barometric pressure trend (zero API keys).

function.name: sky_aviation
function.description: Fetch nearby AviationWeather.gov METAR and TAF reports with decoded FAA flight category (VFR/MVFR/IFR/LIFR), ceiling AGL, visibility SM, wind, and altimeter.

function.name: sky_space_weather
function.description: Fetch live NOAA SWPC planetary Kp index (G0-G5), 10.7cm solar flux (SFI), GOES X-ray radio blackout scale (R0-R5), aurora visibility estimate, and 80m-10m Day/Night HF ham band propagation.

function.name: sky_window_planner
function.description: Evaluate 72-hour Open-Meteo wind/gusts/cloud/CAPE/visibility plus astronomical twilight/darkness & moon phase to score optimal outdoor windows for stargazing, drone, boating, or ham_field_day.

function.name: sky_adsb_traffic
function.description: Fetch live local ADS-B aircraft traffic from a configured local dump1090/readsb receiver or OpenSky Network public bounding-box feed.

function.name: sky_briefing_save
function.description: Persist a SkyWatch severe-weather, HF propagation, or 72-hour activity window briefing into local SQLite.

function.name: sky_station_set
function.description: Save or update a SkyWatch home/field station location (name, lat, lon, optional ICAO hint & local dump1090 URL).
